note: Embed the query, cosine nearest-neighbours over pgvector. Strong on paraphrase and cross-lingual; blind to exact tokens like the cultivar code WL-323. The number every later stage has to beat.

Exact-term match via tsvector + ts_rank_cd. Scored 0.00 until the AND->OR tsquery fix (websearch_to_tsquery ANDs every term, so a whole-question query matched nothing). Honest result: at k=5 it beats the fused hybrid -- an RRF nuance, and exactly why the project did not stop at hybrid.

Reciprocal Rank Fusion (1/(k+60)): fuses the two rankings by position, sidestepping the incomparable cosine-vs-ts_rank score scales. Fixed q05 and q14 over the dense baseline. Gets meaning AND exact codes.

Re-scores the top-20 (query, chunk) candidates read together, keeps the top 5. Fixed 6 questions hybrid missed (q01, q02, q03, q09, q16, q21) with ZERO regressions -- the decisive precision win. Still misses q07, q08, q15, q20, q22: recall gaps (the answer chunk isn't in the pool), not reranker gaps -> the embedder-upgrade lever.
